decision_policy: Enumerate finite attribute hypotheses and propose an action only when stable; otherwise request review while preserving task assistance
reason: An unresolved attribute need not change the appropriate response. Current/past ambiguity and fictional timing should not automatically create an extra alert.
reviewer_questions: Rank unresolved attributes by worst remaining number of possible actions; host reviewer only, no automatic child questioning
scope: Conditional symbolic guarantee; does not validate model hypothesis coverage or real-world safety
prose_diagnostic: 48 separately authored fictional cases, frozen before evaluation
promotion: Compare against released v7 joint focus-turn routing; a high review workload or weaker recall blocks claiming a generally superior replacement
